title: Navimower 0.4.5-beta39

## Dark backend map snapshot and international zone labels

This beta extends the backend Map snapshot image from issue #99 with an optional dark-theme variant and improves zone-label text rendering.

### Dark snapshot image

Each mower now exposes a second Home Assistant image entity:

- **Map snapshot** — the existing light-background snapshot, enabled by default.
- **Map snapshot dark** — a dark-background variant, disabled by default.

The dark renderer keeps the established Map Card semantic colors instead of simply inverting the light image: green zones/mowed area, orange Off-limit, blue VF-off, grey Channels and purple Gate areas are adjusted for contrast on a dark background.

Light and dark snapshots have independent caches. Only snapshot entities that are actually enabled in Home Assistant participate in automatic rendering. `navimower.refresh_map_snapshot` also refreshes only enabled variants, so the disabled dark entity adds no ongoing rendering cost. Users may enable dark and disable light if they only need the dark notification/dashboard image.

### International zone names

Zone labels now use a Unicode-capable TrueType font when available instead of relying on Pillow's minimal default bitmap font. Names containing Estonian, Turkish, Nordic and other Latin-script characters such as `ä ö ü õ Ø ı ş Ł ą` are preserved and rendered directly. Labels are normalized to Unicode NFC before drawing.

No language-specific zone-name substitutions or mower-model rules are used.

### Compatibility

The existing light snapshot entity, image-proxy URL behavior, mower artwork and `navimower.refresh_map_snapshot` action remain compatible.
